product.name: Management Support and Consulting Services
product.description: Provides management support and consulting to improve client companies' corporate value through hands-on involvement in management, DX, marketing, and investment.

product.name: Digital Transformation (DX) Services
product.description: Supports companies in integrating strategy, business process reform, and IT to advance their digital transformation initiatives.

product.name: Marketing and Creative Support
product.description: Delivers marketing strategy and creative execution support to help clients improve market positioning and customer engagement.

product.name: Investment Services
product.description: Conducts equity investments to strengthen management support functions and enhance the value of portfolio companies.
